en: Vintage Romanian postcard featuring a sepia studio portrait of a mustachioed man in 19th‑century attire, standing with one hand on a pedestal. The front is captioned with the name "C. Negruzi." and the series title "Colecția scriitorilor români" with the number 37. The back bears Romanian postcard markings, the publisher line, a museum stamp, and several handwritten inventory numbers.
